label: ECL at/below $115.22: the E4-28 floor is met at g = 4.6% (the filer's organic, acquisition-adjusted fixed-currency sales change FY2018-FY2025, carried by the 2022-2023 inflation years) on the five-year depreciation-end owner earnings of $1,667.5M (post-ChampionX continuing operations) and 280,328,603 cover shares.
